currentMilestone: Personal Agent P1.8 — Conversation Lifecycle & Retention
notes: Proof A and Proof B remain user-confirmed locally. Proof C implementation is now CI-verified across EVO, Eidos and EVO-App-Platform: Eidos UIDL actions flow through ActionHost to App Manager /v1/actions; Trading Lite owns the mapping to EVO public capability discovery and POST /api/v1/commands; EVO PostgreSQL E2E proves public command → BusinessData → Posting → pending production/shipment + receivable balances. Local browser Proof C is now user-confirmed PASS. A public read/query result rendered back in Eidos remains. EVO posting semantics are now explicit: accepted business facts automatically enter the posting lifecycle; QUEUED means EVO-owned asynchronous continuation, not caller-triggered posting. Explicit Posting/PostingRun APIs remain reserved for re-posting, Replay, bulk/recovery and platform control. Recalculation is explicitly two-perspective: EVO internal recalculation rebuilds from EVO runtime cache/data, while Application recalculation is ordinary resubmission that EVO does not specially interpret. A governed scoped runtime-cache clear API is defined at EVO contract level but not yet implemented. Architecture correction: EVO target is a lightweight runtime plugin providing generic BusinessData→PostingRule→Ledger→Balance and runtime clear/export/recalculation capabilities. Identity, permissions, Application/Package lifecycle, capability discovery, rule lifecycle, finance/audit governance and higher-order engines default to Host/plugins. The current evo.core FOUNDATION_RUNTIME seed is Proof-B compatibility data, not a privileged platform-Core contract. The previously prepared local Proof C has now been user-confirmed PASS as a compatibility proof. The target EVO Ledger Runtime ingestion boundary is still generic BusinessDataSubmission rather than platform-owned /commands/capability orchestration. Architecture refinement: EVO does retain one minimal ApplicationAnchor/applicationId. BusinessData and current PostingRules must carry the same applicationId so EVO can route to the correct candidate rule set before condition evaluation. Rich Application lifecycle remains App Platform-owned. User-local Proof C evidence on 2026-09-24: Trading Lite Create Order returned ok=true with a real EVO commandExecutionId, businessDataId, postingInputId, postingSequence=4 and postingStatus=QUEUED. QUEUED is accepted as EVO-owned asynchronous posting continuation; no caller-side posting trigger was required.
currentStep: P1.7 Durable Conversation Threads is verified and closed. P1.7A added Host-owned append-only Conversation Thread state; P1.7B bound thread turns to durable Agent Runs and Host-built conversation history; P1.7C moved Eidos Personal Agent transcript recovery/send to durable Host threads. PR #118 passed 30/30 triggered CI and deployed successfully to Railway at 39f346ef790bdc634848b2dba3a51fe24ad6a4bc / 4fd23d70-0a89-4ae0-b1d0-f3c7402a3b17. P1.8 now starts to define explicit thread lifecycle and retention so durable conversation state does not grow forever and 'new chat' / history management has clear Host semantics. P1.8A begins with append-only thread lifecycle state (ACTIVE/ARCHIVED) and current-Principal/current-Context scoped archive/read/list behavior; physical deletion remains a later retention operation, not an ordinary mutation.
